newsitem.title: usa: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES MIXED IN QUIET TRADING.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES MIXED IN QUIET TRADING.

text.p: Aug 12 - U.S. stock index futures were mixed in quiet midday trading. Sept S&P 500 turns lower. One trader cited selling from a U.S. bank and small sell-stops around 942.00. Trade light overall. CME price boards show 30,000 Sept S&P 500 futures traded so far. Market awaits retail sales and inflation data later this week.
